content: उपपदम् .²1 A word prefixed or previously uttered; धनुरुपपदं वेदम् <ls>Ki. 18. 44</ls> (धनुर्वेदम्); तस्याः स राजोपपदं निशान्तम् <ls>R. 16. 40</ls>. .²2 A title, a degree; epithet of respect, such as आर्य, शर्मन्; कथं निरुपपदमेव चाणक्यमिति न आर्यचाणक्यमिति <ls>Mu. 3</ls>. .²3 A secondary word of a sentence, a preposition, particle <ab>&c.</ab> prefixed to a verb or a noun derived from a verb which determines or qualifies the sense of the verb; उपपदमतिड् <ls>P. II. 2. 19</ls>; (see <ls>Sk.</ls> thereon). ˚तत्पुरुषः a kind of <ab>Tat. comp.</ab> in which the last member is some form of a verbal character; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} वेदविद्, ग्रामणी, आकर्णलम्बिन् <ab>&c.</ab>
